title: USM Orientation Movement Optimizer MVP Data Dictionary
description: Formal data contract defining required tables, schemas, source classifications, units, and validation rules for the discrete-event movement simulator and batch optimizer.

meta.target_campus: Universiti Sains Malaysia (USM) Main Campus, Gelugor, Pulau Pinang

places.description: Geographic locations, staging nodes, boarding zones, choke gates, and terminal event halls across USM campus.

name.description: Human-readable official name of the building, pavilion, or junction.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude coordinate in decimal degrees (EPSG:4326).

lon.description: WGS84 longitude coordinate in decimal degrees (EPSG:4326).

elevation_m.description: Elevation above sea level in meters.

holding_capacity_pax.description: Maximum safe holding capacity before crowding spills onto active vehicular road lanes.

is_shaded.description: True if physical canopy, walkway roof, or building awning shields waiting students from sun and rain.

seating_available.description: True if fixed benches or auditorium seating exist at this waypoint.

entry_gates_count.description: Number of parallel doorway openings or admission inspection lanes active.

service_rate_pax_min.description: Measured or calibrated student throughput per minute across all active lanes.

routes.description: Directed transport and walking corridors between origins and destinations derived via OSM road geometry and OSRM routing.

origin_place_id.description: Foreign key referencing places.place_id for trip start.

destination_place_id.description: Foreign key referencing places.place_id for trip termination.

distance_m.description: Total route network distance calculated along physical paths/roads.

expected_duration_s.description: Free-flow baseline travel duration with zero queue congestion.

free_flow_speed_kmh.description: Unimpeded transit speed (e.g. 4.8 km/h walking, 30.0 km/h bus in-motion).

elevation_gain_m.description: Cumulative elevation climbing meters along the route.

narrow_chokepoints_count.description: Number of bottlenecks (elevated walkway stairs, single-file curbs, unpaved shoulders) along route.

is_pedestrian_segregated.description: True if students walk on grade-separated sidewalks rather than vehicular road shoulders.

waypoints_geojson.description: GeoJSON LineString containing ordered [lon, lat] coordinates.

hostels_and_batches.description: Desasiswa accommodation complexes, cohort demand allocations, and scheduled batch release groups.

cluster.description: Hostel grouping identifier (e.g. 'RST' for Restu-Saujana-Tekun cluster).

total_freshmen_pax.description: Verified number of new orientation students resident in this hostel.

batch_size_pax.description: Target number of students grouped in this release wave (e.g. 40-50 pax for bus, 100 pax for walking platoon).

scheduled_departure_time.description: Scheduled departure time from hostel staging area (HH:MM:SS in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur).

target_arrival_time.description: Mandatory orientation seated check-in deadline (HH:MM:SS in Asia/Kuala_Lumpur).

workers_and_stations.description: PPSL (Pembimbing Program Siswa Lestari) facilitators and marshal checkpoints regulating batch departures, crosswalk safety, and hall admissions.

priority_rank.description: 1-indexed priority ranking for staff assignment when marshal resources are constrained.

required_headcount_ppsl.description: Number of PPSL marshals required to operate this station effectively.

service_capacity_pax_min.description: Maximum student processing rate across station boundary before upstream queue forms.

headcount_delay_s_per_batch.description: Time overhead penalty spent taking nominal roll or verifying batch counts before clearing movement.

has_radio_link.description: True if station possesses walkie-talkie link for upstream pause throttling.

vehicles.description: USM campus transit shuttle coach fleet capacity, cycle times, and boarding dynamics.

vehicle_id.description: Bus registration or fleet unit identifier.

seated_capacity_pax.description: Total passenger seating capacity (44 seats verified on USM standard coach).

standing_capacity_pax.description: Permitted standees (0 for orientation long-distance coach SOP).

boarding_time_s_per_pax.description: Measured dwell time per boarding student through single front door (calibrated at 2.5s).

alighting_time_s_per_pax.description: Measured discharge time per alighting passenger at destination stop (calibrated at 1.2s).

active_fleet_size.description: Number of operating shuttle buses dedicated to the specific hostel route.

round_trip_cycle_s.description: Total round trip duration including transit out, dropoff, return leg, and layover.

observed_traces.description: Empirical field records combining timestamped GPS fixes, pedometer counts, motion states, and video-derived queue metrics.

trace_id.description: Unique identifier for the recording session.

subject_hash.description: Pseudonymous SHA-256 hash of device/student ID to ensure zero PII in public git.

timestamp_iso.description: Exact observation timestamp formatted as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS+08:00 (Asia/Kuala_Lumpur).

horizontal_accuracy_m.description: Reported GNSS horizontal accuracy radius (records with >25m discarded for queue analysis).

cumulative_steps.description: Cumulative pedometer steps since recording origin.

media_clip_ref.description: Associated timestamped video/image file if visual verification was captured at this fix.

visible_headcount_min.description: Lower bound of visible students in frame (calibrated field-of-view sample only, not a census).

visible_headcount_max.description: Upper bound of visible students in frame.

queue_density_pax_m2.description: Estimated local spatial density (e.g. 0.5 for loose column, 3.5 for compacted road reservoir).

baseline_run.description: Locked empirical benchmark representing the unoptimized status-quo commute of 2026-09-17 against which candidate plans are tested.

active_commute_s.description: Active commute duration outside hostel room: 3,546 seconds (59.1 minutes).

bus_ride_moving_s.description: Actual in-vehicle transit time: 185 seconds (3.1 minutes).

hostel_bus_queue_s.description: Stationary and crawl queue duration at Restu pavilion: 1,470 seconds (24.5 minutes).

exterior_dtsp_queue_s.description: Stationary holding reservoir duration in open sun outside DTSP: 1,885 seconds (31.4 minutes).

total_queue_delay_s.description: Sum of hostel queue and DTSP reservoir wait: 3,355 seconds (55.9 minutes).

idle_to_motion_ratio.description: Calibrated idle-to-motion factor (9.27x during 07:34-08:37 active commute window).

effective_transit_speed_kmh.description: Effective point-to-point velocity across commute: 0.58 km/h.

pax_sun_exposure_s.description: Duration spent queuing without overhead shade: 1,885 seconds (31.4 minutes).

candidate_plan.description: Optimization solution specifying staggered batch releases, mode splits, routing corridors, and prioritized PPSL worker posts.

walking_modal_share_pct.description: Percentage of total student cohort assigned to escorted walking platoons.

shuttle_modal_share_pct.description: Percentage of student cohort assigned to bus transit.

batches.description: List of dispatch instructions: [{batch_id, origin_id, departure_time, route_id, mode, pax_count}].

worker_station_allocations.description: Ordered ranked deployment of PPSL staff: [{station_id, priority_rank, marshals_assigned, mandate}].

simulation_result.description: Evaluation metrics produced by running the discrete-event simulator on a candidate plan.

total_students_simulated.description: Total students processed across simulation run.

mean_door_to_seat_s.description: Average duration from room departure to seated hall admission.

total_queue_waiting_s.description: Aggregate non-productive queue time per student.

max_dtsp_exterior_reservoir_pax.description: Peak queue size outside DTSP entry gates (must remain below 120 pax threshold).

late_arrivals_count.description: Number of students seated after the official induction cutoff time.

unshaded_exposure_mean_s.description: Average duration students were held in direct sunlight.

queue_reduction_vs_baseline_pct.description: Percentage reduction in idle queue waiting compared to baseline_run.total_queue_delay_s.

bottleneck_alerts.description: List of station choke warnings where arrival rate exceeded service capacity.
